definitions.name: N_local
definitions.source_text: let N_local[a in age] = S[a] + I[a] + R[a]

transitions.name: infection
transitions.source_text:
infection[a in age] : S[a] --> I[a]
    @ beta * S[a] * sum(b in age, I[b] / N_local[b])

transitions.name: recovery
transitions.source_text:
recovery[a in age] : I[a] --> R[a]
    @ gamma * I[a]

transitions.name: aging
transitions.source_text:
aging[c in compartments, (a, a_next) in consecutive(age)]
    : c[a] --> c[a_next]
    @ (1 / age_dur[a]) * c[a]

transitions.name: death
transitions.source_text:
death[c in compartments, a in age] : c[a] -->
    @ mu * c[a]

transitions.name: birth
transitions.source_text:
birth : --> S[age_0_5]
    @ mu * sum(a in age, N_local[a])

scenarios.name: baseline
slow
